name: ai
description: Chat about your code, edit a selection with a side-by-side preview, fix the problem on a line, explain code and get suggestions at the cursor, with Claude (your own API key) or a local Ollama model. Nothing is sent until you ask.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Claude through Anthropic's API (needs an API key), or a model running on this computer with Ollama, which keeps your code on your machine.

model.title: Claude Model
model.description: claude-opus-5-5 is the most capable; claude-sonnet-5-5 is faster and cheaper; claude-haiku-5-5 is the fastest and cheapest.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How much Claude thinks before answering in chat and edits. Higher is slower and costs more.

suggestEffort.title: Suggestion Effort
suggestEffort.description: Effort for suggestions at the cursor, which should come back quickly.

suggestAsYouType.title: Suggest as You Type
suggestAsYouType.description: Ask for a suggestion whenever you pause typing. Each pause sends a request, which costs money with Claude. Alt-\ asks on demand either way.

sendFileContext.title: Send the Open File
sendFileContext.description: Send the rest of the open file with questions, so answers fit your code. Edits always send the code around the selection.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama Address
ollamaUrl.description: Where Ollama runs. Only this computer is allowed.

ollamaModel.title: Ollama Model
ollamaModel.description: A model you've pulled with `ollama pull`.
